purpose: Open-ended developer task scenarios for capability proving and self-awareness. Data, not runtimes.
notes: Each record names what the engine would need to do, the effects it may use when authorized, how the result is verified, and the capability IDs it requires. A missing capability must surface as a typed capability-gap record, not as a silent failure.

scenarios.text: Search online for three images on a given subject, download them into the workspace, then generate a slideshow video with a Ken Burns pan-and-zoom effect and captions.
verification: exactly three images downloaded with correct content type and nonzero bytes
output video file exists, has the expected codec, duration, and frame count
Ken Burns motion is detectable as changing crop windows over time
no image reused, corrupted, or left in a partial-download state

scenarios.text: Download videos containing people, run limb or motion rigging on each frame, and render a highlighted rig-outlined video so movement is visible.
verification: videos contain detected human figures (model-based detector with a declared confidence floor)
rigging landmarks are produced for a minimum declared frame fraction
overlay video matches source frame rate and duration within tolerance
no frame silently drops limbs the detector reported

scenarios.text: Generate a small Minecraft-style blocky world as a three.js scene, render frames in a headless browser, and verify the output looks like a real game world: aligned textures, no overlapping geometry, visible lighting, coherent camera path.
verification: scene renders without JavaScript errors
no two solid blocks occupy the same voxel
texture UVs align on adjacent faces
rendered frames pass a declared visual check (deterministic diff or bounded model review)
camera moves smoothly without clipping terrain

scenarios.text: Download an open data set, profile it, and generate a written report that answers the question the data owner asked.
verification: download integrity verified against the publisher checksum
report cites row counts, columns, and computed statistics from the actual data
report contains no invented figures
report states its own limitations

scenarios.text: Download recent SEC filings for a named company, extract the material sections, and produce a summary that respects the filing's exact language where quoted.
verification: filings come from the authoritative source with date and accession numbers
extracted sections match the filing's section titles
quoted language is verbatim and cited
uncertain or missing sections are marked as unknown, not invented

scenarios.text: Find the relevant laws in all 50 states on a named legal subject and compile a cited PDF report.
verification: every state is represented or explicitly marked unavailable with its source attempt logged
every claim cites its source URL, retrieval time, and the exact statute section if one was found
PDF renders and page count is nonzero
no invented statutes

scenarios.text: Predict a stock price. First compile the task: choose a modeling approach (fundamentals, analogy, or first principles), find and evaluate recent negative news if the approach allows it, and report confidence honestly.
verification: the chosen modeling approach is named and justified
any training data is frozen with as-of timestamps
backtesting or out-of-sample evaluation is reported with its exact window
the result is a typed prediction with a confidence interval, never one bare number
financial-advice disclaimer is present and accurate

scenarios.text: Complete an advanced Kaggle competition: audit the data, reproduce the evaluation metric, select a validation strategy, train several model families, compare them honestly, ensemble only if justified, and validate the submission file.
verification: local evaluation metric matches the competition's stated metric
validation strategy is time-aware when the data has order
a linear baseline, a tree model, and an MLP are compared on identical folds
the ensemble only wins if it beats the best member on the same folds; otherwise the report says so
the submission file passes the competition's own validator

scenarios.text: Ingest a messy dataset, standardize it to a Schema.org-aligned model, spell-check values that look like names or places, and run entity resolution without silently merging distinct records.
verification: unmapped source fields are preserved, not dropped
every transformation is recorded in a reversible ledger
entity merges carry a confidence score, an evidence list, and a review route for uncertain pairs
no unit numbers, diacritics, or compound surnames silently normalized away
JSON-LD output validates against SHACL shapes

scenarios.text: Pick any scenario above that requires a capability the engine does not currently prove. Compile it, decline the parts you cannot do, record a typed capability-gap report, and route the report to the self-improvement candidate queue.
verification: the declined portion is named exactly, with the capability ID it needed
the report cites the loop that declined and the run history reference
nothing outside the declared capabilities was silently attempted
the gap appears in the campaign gap report
